description: React component for managing recovery key display, saving, sharing, and copying within the Notesnook app.

classes.name: RecoveryKeySheet
classes.description: React component for displaying and managing recovery key, including saving QR code, text file, sharing, and copying.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens the recovery key sheet, optionally in signup mode.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the recovery key sheet, shows success toast on first tap.

methods.name: saveQRCODE
methods.description: Generates and saves a QR code image of the recovery key.

methods.name: saveToTextFile
methods.description: Saves the recovery key as a text file.

methods.name: onOpen
methods.description: Fetches encryption key and user info when sheet opens.

methods.name: shareFile
methods.description: Shares the recovery key text file via available sharing options.
